arxiv-2003-03175.title: Central leaves on Shimura varieties with parahoric reduction
arxiv-2003-03175.creator: Jens Hesse
arxiv-2003-03175.description: Abstract We investigate the geometry of the special fiber of the integral model of a Shimura variety with parahoric level at a given prime place. To be more precise, we deal with the definition of central leaves in this situation, their local closedness, and the relationship between the folations for varying parahoric level.

arxiv-2007-11240.title: Edge-aware Graph Representation Learning and Reasoning for Face Parsing
arxiv-2007-11240.creator: Gusi Te, Yinglu Liu, Wei Hu, Hailin Shi, Tao Mei
arxiv-2007-11240.description: Abstract Face parsing infers a pixel-wise label to each facial component, which has drawn much attention recently. Previous methods have shown their efficiency in face parsing, which however overlook the correlation among different face regions. The correlation is a critical clue about the facial appearance, pose, expression, etc. , and should be taken into account for face parsing.

arxiv-2012-03335.title: Microscopic theory of the polarizability of transition metal dichalcogenides excitons: Application to WSe 2 {}_{\mbox{2}}
arxiv-2012-03335.creator: J. C. G. Henriques 1,2 , M. F. C. Martins Quintela 1 , N. M. R. Peres 1,2∗
arxiv-2012-03335.description: Abstract In this paper we develop a fully microscopic theory of the polarizability of excitons in transition metal dichalcogenides. We apply our method to the description of the excitation 2 2 p dark states. These states are not observable in absorption experiments but can be excited in a pump-probe experiment.

arxiv-2107-07101.title: Joint CFO, Gridless Channel Estimation and Data Detection for Underwater Acoustic OFDM Systems
arxiv-2107-07101.creator: Lei Wan, Jiang Zhu, En Cheng, Zhiwei Xu
arxiv-2107-07101.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose an iterative receiver based on gridless variational Bayesian line spectra estimation (VALSE) named JCCD-VALSE that j ointly estimates the c arrier frequency offset (CFO), the c hannel with high resolution and carries out d ata decoding.

arxiv-2201-08170.title: Unified Explanation of the Anomalies in Semi-Leptonic B B decays and the W W Mass Preprint: PSI-PR-22-02, ZU-TH 02/22
arxiv-2201-08170.creator: Marcel Algueró, Andreas Crivellin, Claudio Andrea Manzari, Joaquim Matias
arxiv-2201-08170.description: Abstract The discrepancies between the measurements of rare (semi-)leptonic B B decays and the corresponding Standard Model predictions point convincingly towards the existence of new physics for which a heavy neutral gauge boson ( Z ′ Z^{\prime} ) is a prime candidate.

arxiv-2206-03293.title: Joint Manifold Learning and Density Estimation Using Normalizing Flows
arxiv-2206-03293.creator: Seyedeh Fatemeh Razavi, Mohammad Mahdi Mehmanchi
arxiv-2206-03293.description: Abstract Based on the manifold hypothesis, real-world data often lie on a low-dimensional manifold, while normalizing flows as a likelihood-based generative model are incapable of finding this manifold due to their structural constraints. So, one interesting question arises: "Can we find sub-manifold(s) of data in normalizing flows and estimate the density of the data on the sub-manifold(s)?" .

arxiv-2409-05614.title: Nature vs Nurture: Three Dimensional MHD Simulations of Misaligned Embedded Circum-Single Disks within an AGN Disk
arxiv-2409-05614.creator: Bhupendra Mishra, Josh Calcino
arxiv-2409-05614.description: Abstract Stellar mass black holes in the disks around active galactic nuclei (AGN) are promising sources for gravitational wave detections by LIGO/VIRGO. Recent studies suggest this environment fosters the formation and merger of binary black holes. Many of these studies often assumed a simple, laminar AGN disk without magnetic fields or turbulence.

arxiv-2409-19343.title: Magnons on a dice lattice: topological features and transport properties
arxiv-2409-19343.creator: Shreya Debnath and Saurabh Basu Department of Physics, Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati, Guwahati-781039, Assam, India
arxiv-2409-19343.description: Abstract In this paper, we study the topological properties of magnons on a dice lattice, also known as the dual of a more widely studied kagome lattice. This structure has a central atom at the center of the honeycomb lattice, which leads to the formation of a flat band.

arxiv-2411-06616.title: MEANT: Multimodal Encoder for Antecedent Information
arxiv-2411-06616.creator: Benjamin Iyoya Irving, Annika Marie Schoene
arxiv-2411-06616.description: Abstract The stock market provides a rich well of information that can be split across modalities, making it an ideal candidate for multimodal evaluation. Multimodal data plays an increasingly important role in the development of machine learning and has shown to positively impact performance. But information can do more than exist across modes— it can exist across time.

arxiv-2505-14565.title: Towards Verifiability of Total Value Locked (TVL) in Decentralized Finance
arxiv-2505-14565.creator: 1 st Pietro Saggese, 2 nd Michael Fröwis, 3 rd Stefan Kitzler, 4 th Bernhard Haslhofer, 5 th Raphael Auer
arxiv-2505-14565.description: Abstract Total Value Locked (TVL) aims to measure the aggregate value of cryptoassets deposited in Decentralized Finance (DeFi) protocols. Although blockchain data is public, the way TVL is computed is not well understood. In practice, its calculation on major TVL aggregators relies on self-reports from community members and lacks standardization, making it difficult to verify published figures independently.

arxiv-2508-06181.title: Beyond Constant Parameters: Hyper Prediction Models and HyperMPC
arxiv-2508-06181.creator: Jan Węgrzynowski, Piotr Kicki, Grzegorz Czechmanowski, Maciej Krupka, Krzysztof Walas
arxiv-2508-06181.description: Abstract Model Predictive Control (MPC) is among the most widely adopted and reliable methods for robot control, relying critically on an accurate dynamics model. However, existing dynamics models used in the gradient-based MPC are limited by computational complexity and state representation.

arxiv-2510-04052.title: Enabling Network Policy Enforcement in Service Meshes Thanks: This work was supported by NSF CNS Award 2213672.
arxiv-2510-04052.creator: Behrooz Farkiani, Fan Liu, Patrick Crowley
arxiv-2510-04052.description: Abstract Portable service mesh implementations enable Layer 4 to Layer 7 policy enforcement across heterogeneous infrastructures, yet they depend on the underlying network’s connectivity and policies. Layer 3 network policies govern IP traffic regardless of whether upper layers authorize the flow.

pmc-11538176.creator: Nikita Prosad Singh, Vuyokazi Ntlantsana, Andrew Tomita, Saeeda Paruk
pmc-11538176.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundAdverse childhood experiences (ACEs), substance use, depressive symptoms, and HIV outcomes in people living with HIV (PLWHIV) have not been comprehensively investigated within a single study.AimThe aim of this study was to investigate the prevalence and association of ACEs, substance use, depressive symptoms and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) outcomes in PLWHIV accessing HIV care during the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic.SettingDistrict hospital HIV clinic in South Africa.MethodsA total of 196 PLWHIV completed a socio-demographic and clinical questionnaire; an adapted World Health Organization

pmc-11591689.title: Advances in the Neuro-Rehabilitation of Parkinson’s Disease: Insights from a Personalized Multidisciplinary Innovative Pathway
pmc-11591689.creator: Maria Grazia Maggio, Mirjam Bonanno, Alfredo Manuli, Rosaria De Luca, Giuseppe Di Lorenzo, Angelo Quartarone, Rocco Salvatore Calabrò, Iro Boura, Cleanthe Spanaki
pmc-11591689.description: Background/Objectives: Parkinson’s disease (PD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder that requires comprehensive and personalized rehabilitation. This retrospective study focused primarily on the usability and patient acceptability of the innovative pathway. In addition, the secondary objective was to evaluate the effectiveness of a personalized and multidisciplinary rehabilitation pathway on cognitive function, especially executive functions.

pmc-11643535.title: Catalytic Performance of Sn-β Zeolites with Different Si/Al Ratios in the Conversion of Glucose to Lactic Acid
pmc-11643535.creator: Xiaowei Zhuang, Yongshun Feng, Hui Qiao, Weiming Yang, Xin Pan, Yi Tang
pmc-11643535.description: Lactic acid is an important platform feedstock for synthesizing various chemicals. Lactic acid is normally converted from any sugar such as glucose, and Sn-β zeolite is an effective catalyst. In this study, β zeolite with different Si/Al ratios was prepared and characterized.

pmc-11715243.title: FDG‐PET patterns of LATE & co: disentangling the pathological heterogeneity of Tau‐negative amnestic syndromes
pmc-11715243.creator: Jesús Silva‐Rodríguez, Alexis Moscoso, Miguel Labrador‐Espinosa, Pascual Sanchez‐Juan, Michael Schöll, Michel J Grothe
pmc-11715243.description: BackgroundAbout 20‐30% of clinically diagnosed AD dementia patients do not meet pathologic criteria for AD and this proportion is even higher in amnestic MCI. Among tau‐negative amnestic patients, limbic‐predominant age‐related TDP‐43 encephalopathy (LATE) has been described as a principal diagnostic alternative, especially at advanced age.

pmc-12515475.title: Health-related quality of life in esophageal cancer: a state-of-the-art review of patient-reported outcomes and an evidence and gap map
pmc-12515475.creator: Kenneth Färnqvist, Kalle Mälberg, Sophie I Johnsson, Asif Johar, Anna Schandl, Cecilia Ringborg, Pernilla Lagergren
pmc-12515475.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Summary Esophageal cancer represents a substantial global health challenge, marked by poor prognosis, even after curative treatment. Health-related quality of life is crucial for evaluating the treatment efficacy and long-term outcomes in patients with esophageal cancer. This state-of-the-art review and evidence gap map sought to identify existing research on the impact of interventions on health-related quality of life in adults with esophageal cancer, providing a comprehensive overview of various health-related quality of life aspects following diagnosis and treatment.

pmc-12614284.title: Change in Healthcare Use After a Self‐Management Supportive Intervention for Low Back Pain—A Quasi‐Experimental Study
pmc-12614284.creator: Søren Grøn, Melker Johansson, Kim Rose Olsen, Bart Koes, Stine Haugaard Clausen, Alice Kongsted
pmc-12614284.description: BackgroundIndividuals with low back pain (LBP) have high healthcare use (HCU). It is currently unclear whether self‐management supportive interventions can decrease HCU among patients with LBP. The aim of this study was to investigate changes in visits to primary care and redeemed prescriptions of analgesics after enrolment in a self‐management supportive programme compared to usual care.

pmc-12747070.title: The Minimally Invasive Posterior Approach: A Novel Technique for Shrapnel Removal in the Knee
pmc-12747070.creator: Mohamed I Abulsoud, Youssef Alkhier Taha, Mohamed Saleh Hemdan, Akram Mohamed Ali, Shashank Kaushik
pmc-12747070.description: Retained periarticular missiles are usually overlooked, though they could lead to several delayed complications, which include infection, mechanical symptoms, synovitis due to lead particle deposition, lead arthropathy, and systemic lead poisoning. Retrieval of this shrapnel could be open or arthroscopic.

pmc-13146513.title: Hounsfield unit and gray-white matter ratio estimates in pediatric normal controls used in studies evaluating head computed tomography
pmc-13146513.creator: Kie Honjo, Geraldine Goco, Eva Ta, Suzanne Laughlin, Anne-Marie Guerguerian
pmc-13146513.description: Head computed tomography (CT) plays a key diagnostic role in assessing anatomically visible cerebral injury, monitoring the development of edema and ischemia, and, in some diseases, assisting in the prediction of outcome. More specifically, after a cardiac arrest, head CT imaging will reveal the impact of global hypoxic-ischemic injury.

pmc-13240064.title: From Plate to Patient: A Systematic Review of Food‐Related Campylobacteriosis Case Reports
pmc-13240064.creator: Minoo Moghimani, Fateme Asadi Touranlou, Lida Jarahi, Asma Afshari
pmc-13240064.description: Background and AimsCampylobacteriosis, primarily caused by Campylobacter jejuni, C. coli, and C. fetus, remains the leading bacterial cause of foodborne gastroenteritis globally, with increasing incidence in both developed and developing nations.MethodsThis systematic review synthesizes case reports of food‐related campylobacteriosis published between January 2000 and September 2024, retrieved from Web of Science, PubMed, ScienceDirect, Scopus, and Google Scholar.

pmc-13256427.title: Extracellular Vesicle-Mediated Communication in Sellar Tumors: A Conceptual and Translational Framework
pmc-13256427.creator: Pierlorenzo Veiceschi, Giuseppa D’Amico, Giovanni Tringali, Francesco Cappello, Celeste Caruso Bavisotto, Alessandra Maria Vitale
pmc-13256427.description: Sellar tumors, including pituitary neuroendocrine tumors (PitNETs), craniopharyngiomas, and rare malignant entities, represent a heterogeneous group of lesions characterized by complex interactions within the tumor microenvironment (TME). In recent years, extracellular vesicles (EVs) have emerged as key mediators of intercellular communication, playing a crucial role in tumor progression, invasion, and therapeutic resistance across multiple cancer types.

pmc-13570167.creator: Naomi Rahimi‐Levene
pmc-13570167.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Commentary on: Proudlove et al. Efficiency and Safety Gains from Bedside Electronic Transfusion Checks in four hospitals in England. British Journal of Haematology 2026; 209:1311‐1320. In this issue, Proudlove et al. compare the manual procedure of group and screen (G&S) sample taking and transfusion administration to a bedside electronic transfusion check (BETC) system, where barcode confirmation of patient identification is used with a form to submit to a third paperless system.
